title: Server info (GET /api/server, 200)
description: Readers: OpenPairings (the public-publishing consent dialog) and Alnasl (its connection test reads the status only). Open route, no credential, Cache-Control: no-store. A server too old to have the route answers Phoenix's own 404.

operator.description: Who runs the server, or null when not configured.

terms_url.description: The terms the arbiter is asked to read; this server's own /terms page when none is configured.

public_registration.description: Whether POST /api/installations hands out keys: unavailable (public publishing not enabled on this server), open, closed.

public_publishing.description: Whether installation keys may write: unavailable, active, paused.
